scientific_integrity: The listed powers are proven by a universal PBW coefficient calculation; finite enumerations are corroborating examples rather than proof for arbitrary fields. Known special-parameter linear-form nilpotence is acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Applies to two-generator cubically truncated skew polynomial algebras over finite fields, not arbitrary quantum complete intersections; does not classify isomorphism classes or module Jordan types. Publication-priority comparison is provisional.
title: Cyclotomic gaps in the nilpotency-index spectrum of nine-dimensional quantum complete intersections
